results.content: Please note that log in via username/password is only available to Repository staff. ## Navigating the Ambiguity of Impact Investing: How Impact Venture Capitalists Access New Markets, Founders, and Capital. ##### Published version. Rather than resolving the elusiveness of impact, we examine how impact venture capitalists (IVCs) leverage this ambiguity in their everyday practices. Second, they tactically employ ambiguity to attract limited partner (LP) capital earmarked for impact investments. We discuss the ethical dimension of these tactics, highlighting how the normative question of what constitutes social and environmental change arises from the practical use of the ambiguous term impact. In doing so, we identify an ethical tension: while the flexibility of the term impact fosters new ways of thinking about social and environmental change, it also risks being used for purely financial gain. We conclude by reflecting on the implications of this ethical tension for both the practice and research of impact investing. ## Journal Title. ## Publisher. ## Publisher DOI.
